title: I Let Claude Run My Shopify Store for a Day
description:
The official Shopify connector for Claude lets you add products, create discount codes, move inventory between locations, browse orders, view customer details and pull real analytics, then ask for concrete ways to raise your conversion rate. Made by Shopify, works on Claude web, desktop, mobile, Claude Code and the API, and it takes about two minutes to connect.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/175qoqTHy7mv43rBv6raXtNRDLV1ABZJNjicrlVfxXl8/edit?usp=sharing
